ns2:course.label: Economics of Risk
ns2:course.description: Exploration of economic decisions under uncertainty. Includes expected utility theory and non-expected utility theory; applications to individual decision problems in investment and insurance; general equilibrium in markets under uncertainty, including problems generated by asymmetric information; measurement of risk; the value of information obtained before a decision. Prerequisite: ECON 302 or equivalent; one of MATH 220 or MATH 221 or equivalent.
